item.title: Vintage Movies Society Just Needs to Let Die
item.description: Every year, like clockwork, the same movies crawl back into our collective lives. Not because we rediscover them, but because we’ve never actually let them go. They’re on TV, they’re streaming, they’re quoted at family gatherings, and somehow we all agree to watch them again, often against our better judgment. These films aren’t bad. Some were even great. item.description: Growing up in the ’80s, ’90s, or early 2000s meant constantly walking a fine line between fitting in and becoming that kid.
